Cognitive Decline

Ailment cognitive-decline memory-loss brain-health dementia

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Progressive decline in cognitive function including memory, thinking, and reasoning.

Symptoms

  • memory-loss
  • confusion
  • difficulty-concentrating
  • brain-fog

Remedies for This Condition

  • Magnesium L-Threonate
    Special form of magnesium that crosses the blood-brain barrier to support cognitive function.
  • Lion's Mane Mushroom
    Medicinal mushroom that supports nerve growth factor (NGF) production and cognitive function.
  • Bugleweed
    Herb used traditionally to reduce fluid retention, particularly when related to thyroid dysfunction or heart conditions.
  • Nettles Root (Urtica dioica)
    Nutrient-dense herb with anti-inflammatory properties, rich in minerals and beneficial for allergies.
